company.name: Polytomic
company.shortDescription: Sync internal data to your business systems
company.description:
Polytomic is a software company whose mission is to make internal data accessible. Internal data within companies is fragmented across many different systems; accessing relevant slices of outside of a team's home system is cumbersome. Polytomic allows business teams to easily access all the data located outside of their home system. 


Polytomic is headquartered in San Francisco, California, USA.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that supports ETL, Reverse ETL, CDC streaming, and general data synchronization between data warehouses, databases, cloud applications, spreadsheets, and APIs.
productsAndServices.name: Polytomic Unified Data Sync Platform

productsAndServices.description: An API-driven service that automates data synchronization from any API endpoint to databases, warehouses, webhooks, business applications, or spreadsheets without coding.
productsAndServices.name: Polytomic API Endpoints

productsAndServices.description: An option to deploy Polytomic’s data sync platform on private cloud infrastructure to meet enterprise security and compliance requirements.
productsAndServices.name: Polytomic Self-Hosted Deployment

productsAndServices.description: Pre-built two-way connectors that enable data synchronization between popular SaaS applications, databases, and data warehouses without coding.
productsAndServices.name: Polytomic Integrations

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows users to define custom data models and transformations using native SQL within the Polytomic platform.
productsAndServices.name: Polytomic SQL Data Modeling and Transformations
